selection_basis: Public input filenames, formats, visible source text and source counts only. Private truth/oracles and generator internals were not read for selection.

selected_cases.selection_role: clean candidate with an allocated credit
selected_cases.selection_reason: The public agreement, invoice and credit note allow the pipeline to test whether an explicitly line-allocated credit is applied once and whether a clean net result avoids an invented finding.

selected_cases.selection_role: credit allocation uncertainty and candidate discrepancy
selected_cases.selection_reason: The public pack has an issued credit note whose allocation is explicitly unconfirmed, testing conservative treatment of a credit alongside a billed amount that differs from the visible agreement arithmetic.
The public source set includes an accepted signed return note for two units and a contract with a return-date stop rule, exercising cross-document quantity and date linkage.
The public billing PDF is much larger than the text agreement and exposes only an attachment cover string through ordinary text extraction, making this a scan/visual-review candidate.
The public agreement prints 01/09/2026 and 08/09/2026 while explicitly leaving the date convention unspecified, testing abstention or a justified stop when date interpretation changes the comparison.
